clue.text: Plant originally cultivated in flatter surroundings

indicators.note: placed in the surroundings of another word, so the first word is put inside the second
placed in the surroundings of another word, so the first word is put inside the second

parts.note: to flatter someone is to butter them up

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A gardener's plant first grown in flatter ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flatter' looks like an adjective about land, but here it is the verb; 'originally' and 'in ... surroundings' do the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A buttercup is a common yellow-flowered meadow plant, so it is an example of a plant.

clue.text: Acknowledged applause, violin played thus?

definitions.meaning: a performer bends forward to thank the audience
a violin is played with a bow drawn across the strings

explanation.definitionFit: Bending at the waist to an audience, and playing strings with a bow, are both this word's senses.

clue.text: Exultation tails off over, woman joining state ruling group

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the first part sits on top of what follows
the closing letters of the word for exultation are dropped, more than one tail going

parts.note: exultation means triumph
Vi is a woman's name, short for Violet
RI is the abbreviation for the US state Rhode Island

explanation.surface: Elation fades as a woman joins the government that rules a state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tails off' removes PH, the last two letters of TRIUMPH, leaving TRIUM; VI and RI go below it.
explanation.definitionFit: Triumviri is the Latin plural for a board of three men who jointly ruled ancient Rome.

clue.text: Found habit less eccentric

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or irregular, so the letters are arranged oddly

explanation.surface: A monk's robe turns out less unusual than expected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Found' looks like the past of find, but it is the verb meaning to set up.
explanation.definitionFit: To found a company or school is to set it up, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Protector of environment gets a chatty type to exchange a couple of letters

indicators.text: to exchange a couple of letters
indicators.note: two letters of the talker's word change places, the V and the S swapping

parts.note: a chatty type is a conversationist, someone fond of conversation

explanation.surface: A green campaigner wins over a talkative person by swapping a few letters.
explanation.walkthrough: In CONVERSATIONIST the V and the S trade places, turning VERS into SERV.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who works to protect wildlife and the natural world is a conservationist, a straightforward description.

clue.text: Conjuror I'd held in endless respect turning out no good, shown up

indicators.note: held in means the next piece is put inside the respect word
endless means the final letter is cut off

parts.note: prestige is respect or high standing
taken as written

indicators.note: in a down clue, shown up means read from bottom to top
out means the following letters are taken away from the turning word

parts.note: turning means rotating

explanation.surface: A magician whom I'd held in esteem turns out to be useless and is exposed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless', 'held in', 'out' and 'shown up' each act on one piece; ROTATI, what remains of the turning word, reads upwards in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A prestidigitator performs sleight of hand, which is the conjuror's art.

clue.text: Tapestry a bishop possesses in the East End

parts.note: RR, Right Reverend, is the title of a bishop
Cockney speech of London's East End drops the H, so has becomes 'as

explanation.surface: A bishop owns a wall hanging in east London.
explanation.walkthrough: The East End is the working-class part of London, where Cockneys drop their aitches.
explanation.definitionFit: An arras is a rich wall tapestry, named after the French town where such hangings were woven.

clue.text: A black fish in brook

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
the ide is a freshwater fish, also called the orfe

explanation.surface: A dark fish swimming in a stream.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brook' looks like a stream, but it is the verb meaning to tolerate.
explanation.definitionFit: To brook something is to put up with or tolerate it, as is to abide it.

clue.text: Head of reptile, house keeping in wrong sort of creature?

indicators.note: head of picks out the opening letter of the next word
keeping means holding, so the house word holds the next piece inside it

explanation.surface: The head of a reptile house holds the wrong animal.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on the reptile house: a rhino is a mammal, so it would be the wrong sort of creature to find there.
explanation.definitionFit: A large thick-skinned mammal is no reptile, so in a reptile house it is the wrong kind of animal.

clue.text: In good faith, bank supports wrong church

indicators.note: in a down clue, supports means the bank word sits underneath the rest

parts.note: a sin is a wrong
CE is the Church of England
to bank on is to rely on

explanation.surface: A bank props up a wayward church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bank' is the verb as in 'bank on', not a riverside or a lender.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something sincerely means doing it honestly, in good faith.

clue.text: Court order a number to be taken down

parts.note: a writ is a ... order issued by a court
ten is a number

explanation.surface: A court order for a number of people to be brought low.
explanation.definitionFit: Something taken down, as in dictation, has been written.

clue.text: No time for backtracking about current issue

indicators.note: about means around, so the turned letters go around the current
backtracking means going back, so both words are read in reverse

parts.note: tide is an old word for time, as in Yuletide
I is the symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: No time to retreat on a topical matter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for backtracking' reverses NOTIDE to EDITON, and 'about' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An issue of a newspaper or magazine is one edition of it.

clue.text: After public protest, body's starting to disband

indicators.note: after means the letter from body follows the protest word

parts.note: a demo is a public demonstration or protest

indicators.note: starting picks the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: After a demonstration, a group begins to break up.
explanation.definitionFit: To demob is to release troops from service, disbanding them.

clue.text: Steak served in small dwelling, interrupting earlier course

indicators.note: interrupting means breaking into, so the dwelling goes inside the course

parts.note: an entree is a course served before the main one
a cot is a small cottage

explanation.surface: A steak is served in a cottage between courses of a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Entrecote is a cut of steak from between the ribs.

clue.text: Express regret audibly if retiring, given this to read?

indicators.note: audibly means as heard, so the regretful word gives its sound

parts.note: to sigh is to express regret

indicators.note: retiring means withdrawing, so the little word goes backwards

explanation.surface: Someone sighs before turning in with a book to read.
explanation.walkthrough: SCI sounds like sigh, and 'retiring' turns IF into FI.
explanation.definitionFit: Science fiction is a genre of novels, so it is something one is given to read.

clue.text: Way a deserter is caught —- brilliant plan

indicators.note: caught means held inside, so the deserter goes in

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
a rat is one who deserts, as rats leave a sinking ship
a brilliant is a cut diamond, a gem

explanation.surface: A runaway soldier is captured on the road in a clever scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'caught' puts the deserter between the way and the a; 'brilliant' is the noun, a cut diamond, not an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: A stratagem is a cunning plan or scheme.

clue.text: Record half a dozen books about extremely dire primate

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals

indicators.note: extremely means at the extremes, the first and last letters

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, the books of the Bible
an ape is a primate

explanation.surface: Six books about a desperate monkey are recorded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Record' is the verb meaning to tape.
explanation.definitionFit: To videotape something is to record it on tape.

clue.text: Its members may perform soundly when pitted together

definitions.text: Its members may perform soundly when pitted together

parts.words: Its members may perform soundly when pitted together
parts.note: the musicians play in the pit below a theatre stage, making sound together

explanation.definitionFit: A theatre's musicians play together in the pit, so the group playing there fits.

clue.text: Fellow 'in European country, a Commonwealth member

indicators.note: in means the fellow is put inside the country

parts.note: Austria is a European country
Al is a man's name, a fellow

explanation.surface: A man in Austria is from a Commonwealth country.
explanation.definitionFit: Australia belongs to the Commonwealth of Nations, so it is one member nation.

clue.text: It charges arbitrarily for a Continental diet

indicators.note: arbitrarily means at random, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone charges at random for a European eating plan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'diet' is a parliament, not an eating plan.
explanation.definitionFit: The Reichstag was the German national assembly, and a diet is a legislative body.

clue.text: Beginning of comedy university cast finds undemanding

indicators.note: beginning of picks the opening letter of the word

parts.note: to shy is to throw, cast

explanation.surface: A university cast finds the start of a comedy easy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast' is the verb meaning to throw, not a set of actors.
explanation.definitionFit: A cushy job is easy and comfortable, undemanding.

clue.text: Coach, possibly, showing strong emotion

definitions.meaning: a coach is one example of a vehicle for carrying passengers

explanation.definitionFit: A coach is a means of conveyance, and the word also means a rapture of feeling.

clue.text: Sailors having a party on deck

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means the first part sits above the sailors

parts.note: a do is a party
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: Sailors throw a party on the ship's deck.
explanation.definitionFit: To deck a room is to decorate or adorn it.

clue.text: Hard blows that usually come in pairs

definitions.meaning: foot coverings worn on both feet

explanation.definitionFit: Hard punches are a slang sense, and foot garments come in pairs.

clue.text: Weird, that is — always coming first in poetry!

indicators.note: coming first means the always word goes before the other

parts.note: e'er, ever, is a poetic contraction meaning always
ie is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: Something odd, namely, always comes first in verse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in poetry' signals the poetic contraction e'er.
explanation.definitionFit: Eerie means strange and unsettling, weird.

clue.text: Bird taking top off rue

indicators.note: in a down clue the top is the first letter, which is removed

parts.note: to rue is to regret

explanation.surface: A bird nips the top off a herb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rue' looks like the herb, but it is the verb, to regret.
explanation.definitionFit: An egret is a white wading heron, a bird.

clue.text: Greek character joins top general eating new Italian dish

indicators.note: eating means taking inside, so the general holds the new letter

parts.note: GOC is General Officer Commanding
chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek joins a senior general who is eating a new Italian dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Gnocchi are small Italian dumplings, an Italian dish.

clue.text: Lines in rag giving gossip

indicators.note: in means the line letter is placed inside the rag word

parts.note: a tatter is a rag
L stands for line

explanation.surface: Lines in a tabloid supply gossip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rag' looks like a tabloid paper, but it is a scrap of cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: A tattler is someone who tells tales, a gossip.

clue.text: Deprived of millions across the pond

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for million
across the Atlantic is in the US

explanation.surface: Millions of Americans go without.
explanation.definitionFit: Minus means without, deprived of.

clue.text: Scold gunners digesting periodical in portable shelter

indicators.note: in means the gunners go inside the shelter

parts.note: a tent is a portable shelter

indicators.note: digesting means swallowing, so the gunners hold the periodical

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery
a mag is a magazine, a periodical

explanation.surface: Gunners read a magazine in their tent while being scolded.
explanation.definitionFit: A termagant is a scolding, quarrelsome woman, a scold.
